points.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin plan a three-way meeting
points.summary: The White House says President Trump will hold trilateral talks with China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen next week, alongside the APEC summit. Nuclear weapons are expected to be on the agenda.

points.headline: FAA ground stop snarls US air travel
points.summary: A telecommunications failure forced the FAA to halt departures nationwide on Friday. The stop has been lifted, but thousands of flights were canceled or delayed and disruption carried into Sunday, ahead of Thanksgiving travel.

points.headline: Nvidia spy scandal shakes Washington
points.summary: NBC reports Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned amid a scandal involving a suspected Chinese spy. It has also opened a public feud between the Treasury and Commerce secretaries over how chip exports to China were policed.

points.headline: US loses measles elimination status
points.summary: Researchers with knowledge of Pan American Health Organization deliberations say the United States no longer counts as a country where measles is eliminated, after sustained spread of the disease.

points.headline: Türkiye and Qatar sign a mutual defense pact
points.summary: President Erdogan and Qatar's emir signed five agreements in Istanbul, led by a mutual defense pact, plus deals on education, consumer protection and conflict resolution.
